blocks.html:
Get your Food Delivery vehicles wrapped

During this lockdown period, customers are contacting us to help still advertise their businesses. Restaurants are asking us to wrap their Food Delivery Vehicles. Whether you are a small enterprise or part of a chain, advertising now more than ever has been important.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto can help you with taking your advertising mobile. We offer vehicle graphics, window graphics, and temporary solutions like magnets like we did for this Security Company. Whatever graphics you are looking to add to your we can print it on apply to your vehicle. If you are just looking to get small Decals/stickers or magnets, then you can apply them yourself.

If you are looking to make a statement with the wrap, we can wrap your whole car or do a partial wrap. This all depends on your vision and budget. Our in-house graphics team will work with you to ensure the advertising is clear and gets the right message across. These Food Delivery Vehicles can really stand out and ensure all the whole neighbourhood knows that you are open.

If you choose to install the smaller vinyl decals or magnets, then our team will help with installation methods and aftercare. Our installation team has years of experience and is more than willing to help answer any questions.
We will mention that although magnets are great as a temporary advert, the care and maintenance are more than vinyl decals. We always recommend that you check with the owner of the car or the leasing company before doing any modifications to your vehicle.
